cases.sentence: Она заполнит твои дворцы, дома твоих приближенных и дома всех египтян; такого не видели ни твои отцы, ни деды с того дня, как поселились в этой земле, и до ___».
cases.explain: «сегодняшнего дня» — after the preposition «до», the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: Your houses shall be filled, and the houses of all your servants, and the houses of all the Egyptians, as neither your fathers nor your fathers’ fathers have seen, since the day that they were on the earth to this day.’ ” He turned, and went out from Pharaoh.

cases.sentence: Она напала на Египет, опустившись на страну в ___.
cases.explain: «огромном количестве» — after the preposition «в», for location or topic.
cases.translation: The locusts went up over all the land of Egypt, and rested in all the borders of Egypt. They were very grievous. Before them there were no such locusts as they, nor will there ever be again.

cases.sentence: Ни на дереве, ни на каком ___ во всем Египте не осталось зелени.
cases.explain: «другом растении» — after the preposition «на», for location or topic.
cases.translation: For they covered the surface of the whole earth, so that the land was darkened, and they ate every herb of the land, and all the fruit of the trees which the hail had left. There remained nothing green, either tree or herb of the field, through all the land of Egypt.

cases.sentence: Моисей поднял руку к небу, и ___ покрыла Египет на три дня.
cases.explain: «непроницаемая тьма» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: Moses stretched out his hand toward the sky, and there was a thick darkness in all the land of Egypt for three days.
